div.div: صِيَاغَةٌ The craft, or art, (K, TA,) or work, or operation, (S, O, Msb, * TA,) of the صَائِغ [q. v.]; (S, O, Msb, K, TA;) [generally meaning the craft or art, or the work or operation, of the goldsmith;] the act of melting [gold &c.], and pouring [it] forth into a mould; [&c.; (see 1, first sentence;)] as also ↓ صِيغَةٌ and ↓ صَيْغُوغَةٌ , this last mentioned by Lh. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
